title_en: Urban Maintenance and Construction Tax Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: Article 1: Units and individuals that pay value-added tax (VAT) and consumption tax within the territory of the People's Republic of China shall be taxpayers of city maintenance and construction tax, and shall pay city maintenance and construction tax in accordance with this Law.

Article 2: The city maintenance and construction tax shall be based on the amount of VAT and consumption tax actually paid by the taxpayer according to law.
The tax basis of city maintenance and construction tax shall be deducted from the amount of VAT refunded due to the end-of-period tax refund retention in accordance with the provisions.
The specific measures for determining the tax basis of city maintenance and construction tax shall be formulated by the State Council pursuant to this Law and relevant tax laws and administrative regulations, and shall be reported to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress for recordation.

Article 3: The city maintenance and construction tax shall not be levied on the amount of VAT and consumption tax paid on imported goods or on labor services, services, and intangible assets sold by overseas units and individuals to within China.
Article 5: The tax payable on city maintenance and construction tax shall be calculated by multiplying the tax basis by the applicable tax rate.

Article 6: When necessary for the development of the national economy and social development, the State Council may prescribe reduction or exemption of city maintenance and construction tax for circumstances such as major public infrastructure construction, special industries and groups, and response to major emergencies, and shall report to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress for recordation.

Article 7: The time when the obligation to pay city maintenance and construction tax arises shall be consistent with the time when the obligation to pay VAT and consumption tax arises, and the payment shall be made simultaneously with VAT and consumption tax.

Article 8: Withholding agents for city maintenance and construction tax shall be units and individuals that have the obligation to withhold VAT and consumption tax, and shall withhold city maintenance and construction tax at the same time as withholding VAT and consumption tax.

Article 9: The collection and administration of city maintenance and construction tax shall be carried out by the tax authorities in accordance with this Law and the Tax Collection and Administration Law of the People's Republic of China.

Article 10: Where taxpayers, tax authorities or their staff members violate the provisions of this Law, they shall be investigated for legal liability in accordance with the Tax Collection and Administration Law of the People's Republic of China and relevant laws and regulations.

Article 11: This Law shall come into force on September 1, 2021. The Interim Regulations of the People's Republic of China on City Maintenance and Construction Tax promulgated by the State Council on February 8, 1985 shall be abolished simultaneously.
